text:
[NGST.2.1] The shortest complete integration there is: create an engine,
arrange to observe it, give it a schema, put a fact in, run it, take the fact
out, shut it down. Every later section of this guide adds to that skeleton
rather than replacing it.

One piece of the ordering is not stylistic. Callbacks are registered **before**
any work happens, because an unregistered callback drops silently
([NCBK.1.8]) -- register them after the first assert and that assert's events
are simply gone, with nothing to indicate they existed.
